questions.question: You’re running late for an important meeting, and your colleague says, *'I’m sorry, I’ll be late. My train was delayed by half an hour.'* What would be the most appropriate response?
options: Oh, that’s fine! I’ve got plenty of time.
That’s really kind of you to say. I’ll wait for you.
I see. I’ll just make sure I leave earlier next time.
You’re too polite. I’m sorry to keep you waiting.

questions.question: A friend asks, *'Would you like to come to my birthday party this weekend?'* What is the best way to politely decline while offering an alternative?
options: No, thanks. I don’t like parties.
I’m sorry, I can’t make it, but I’d love to go another time.
Sure, I’ll come. It sounds fun!
I don’t know. Maybe next time.
questions.answer: I’m sorry, I can’t make it, but I’d love to go another time.

questions.question: During a discussion in a formal business meeting, someone suggests, *'We should consider expanding our market into Asia.'* Another participant says, *'That’s a great idea. I think we should definitely go ahead with it.'* What is the most appropriate follow-up response?
options: Yes, that’s a brilliant suggestion. I’ll look into the logistics.
I’m not sure about that. We need more research first.
I agree, but we should also look at Europe first.
That’s a good point. Let’s discuss the budget next.
questions.answer: Yes, that’s a brilliant suggestion. I’ll look into the logistics.

questions.question: Your neighbour says, *'I’m really sorry to bother you, but could you help me move some furniture?'* What is the most polite way to respond?
options: No, I can’t help you. I’m busy.
Oh, that’s okay. I’m happy to help!
I’m afraid I can’t, but I’ll let you know if I can assist later.
You’re too kind. I’ll just do it myself.
questions.answer: Oh, that’s okay. I’m happy to help!

questions.question: In a casual conversation with a friend, you say, *'I think modern music is too loud and distracting. I prefer classical.'* Your friend disagrees and says, *'That’s your opinion, but I think everyone should enjoy what they like.'* What is the best way to respond to maintain a respectful debate?
options: You’re probably right. I’ll start listening to something else.
I see your point. Maybe we should agree to disagree.
I disagree—classical music is far superior in many ways.
I respect your taste, but I still think loud music is a problem.
questions.answer: I see your point. Maybe we should agree to disagree.
